newsitem.title: USA: Applied Voice names Skamser president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Applied Voice names Skamser president/COO.

text.p: Applied Voice Recognition Inc said Thursday that it has named Charles Skamser as its president and chief operating officer. Skamser, said the company, will manage its U.S. operations and direct its international expansion.

Applied Voice has announced a strategic plan to expand sales and application development centers into 11 major cities by the end of 1998, subject to market conditions. These cities include New York, Boston, Los Angeles, San Francisco, London and Tokyo.
Prior to joining Applied Voice, Skamser was a vice president at Dynasty Technologies Inc, a provider of client/server application development tools.
Applied Voice develops automated speech recognition applications for a variety of industries.
